miriam: post-deploy smoke for r-2026 started in eu1, baseline p95=108ms
devbot: [auto] synth-run id=kv-prefill-eu1-11b4; compare=108ms; timeout=6s
jon: seeing p95 spike to ~720ms and ~2% 5xx on kv-prefill probe
alex: checking node metrics  minority of hosts show GC pauses ~1.5s and TCP retransmits at 08:46 UTC
miriam: pause rollout and pin to stable v1.2.3 for eu1 until we investigate
devbot: routing override applied -> pinned eu1 -> v1.2.3; canary weight -> 0% at 08:48 UTC; note=rollback-pin by miriam
telemetry-bot: synth snapshot pre-pin p95=720ms (08:47), post-pin p95=140ms (08:50), 5xx 2.0% -> 0.3%
alex: tail logs from host-13: ```2026-03-21T08:46:55Z host-13 gc_pause=1.5s prefix_fetch=488ms
2026-03-21T08:46:56Z prefixcache miss key=ab-21 backend_fetch=472ms```
miriam: likely cold prefix cache + occasional GC. plan: 1) pin (done) 2) sequential drain+restart affected hosts 3) run low-cq warmup hitting hot prefixes for 6m
jon: extending smoke grace window +120s for rollout r-2026 to avoid churn while warmup runs
alex: rotation started, one host at a time. warmup job firing at ~5 qps against top-100 prefixes
telemetry-bot: post-warmup snapshot (08:57): p50=32ms p95=130ms 5xx=0.1% -> within thresholds
miriam: once alex confirms rotations complete, we'll run a 5% canary for 15m then promote if stable. leaving thread open 30m.
